features.title: Read-only ledger provenance instrument and mutation-focused fixtures
features.description: Find the earliest verified RESOLVED addition with a separate creation control; classify GitHub-committed flips as undetermined before comparing direct-commit author names.
acceptance_criteria: Bash 3.2/BSD-compatible read-only CLI returns exactly one verdict line containing flip and creation full SHAs (or explicit none), no names or email addresses; successful classifications return 0 and instrument failures return 2.
Earliest verified added RESOLVED row is selected, including root and created-already-RESOLVED cases; removed-only changes and later rewords cannot replace the original flip.

Default self patterns cover sunholo-voight-kampff and Voight-Kampff (bot); validated case-insensitive --self name ERE overrides work; GitHub-like committer ambiguity takes precedence over author matching.
Fixture arms A1-A13 assert verdicts, return codes, independent flip and creation SHAs, stdout line count and no identity-address leakage; A1 also proves the old -S selects fleet creation.
Each test arm names its killed mutation and actual disposable mutation probes demonstrate the relevant failure; no production script is modified by probes.
Missing file/row, duplicate row, malformed options/IDs/patterns, uncommitted target, shallow history and git failures surface rc 2 rather than never-resolved.

/bin/bash scripts/test_mission_ledger_provenance.sh and /bin/bash -n scripts/mission_ledger_provenance.sh scripts/test_mission_ledger_provenance.sh pass outside the planner sandbox after implementation.

features.title: Gate mirrors, CI wiring and changelog

Only fleet from a non-squash flip triggers SELF-RESOLUTION/reopen/flag; undetermined:squash-merge reports both commits without reopening or asking for confirmation on that basis; rc 2 stops provenance-dependent action.

make/test.mk adds the fixture via LAUNCHD_SUITE plus both script syntax checks; make -n test-launchd-drivers shows the commands and make test-launchd-drivers passes outside sandbox. Existing shell classifier and macOS CI job run the target without workflow edits.

Real history returns undetermined:squash-merge for D-FLEET-13/14/15 with flip 996c411a4 and controls 32d19153a/845bbbbdf/752ee765a; D-FLEET-1 has literal RESOLVED flip e6990da9a and creation control b222b2eea, respecting its legacy RULED creation.
The dated changelog fragment opens with ### Fixed and explains both corrected flip selection and conservative squash ambiguity.

make test-changed, make check-no-personal-email check-changelog check-file-sizes, mirror cmp, sprint JSON validator and jq -e . pass; unavailable sandbox checks are reported as UNINFORMATIVE UNDER SANDBOX and rerun outside.
